written_before: any test-time-training variant was run or scored; only the frozen live checkpoint's full-sample numbers (already published as R1) were recomputed to check the replay matches R1
question: Does test-time training (a small update on each realized Gloria turn, encoder frozen) fix the Gloria head's confidence without hurting its ranking?

data.population: R1's: admitted exchanges (jepa_self_head.exchanges) with her words, after the live checkpoint's training time (21 September 04:15) and before 31 October 00:00 local; one row per distinct Gloria text; input the six turns before the exchange, legacy schema; one-day rule as in build_pairs; every window ends on his reply
data.sealed_week: nothing on or after 31 October is encoded, ranked or used as a candidate; the ranking pool and the joiner see only exchanges before the cutoff
data.split: chronological: the first 38 rows (selection half) and the last 39 rows (scoring half). Online state carries over: a variant enters the scoring half with whatever it learned in the selection half.

protocol: each step: forecast (embedding + confidence), then reveal the target, then (TTT variants) update. Forecasts are always made before the update that uses their own target.
scored_by: jepa_ranking_audit.evaluate/_summary (ranking, controls: context-copy, voice centroid, recent turn) and jepa_calibration_audit.joined_rows/spear/bins (confidence vs cosine error, control decode similarity), unchanged
confidence: -logvar of the Gloria row (the head's own confidence), except F3b

F1.what: TTT readout only: Gloria head layer + Gloria logvar row; trunk and encoder frozen; one Adam step on the newest outcome; grad clip 1.0

F2.what: TTT readout with a replay buffer (latest 16 outcomes) and an EWC anchor to the live weights (diagonal Fisher from the pre-checkpoint Gloria pairs, mean-normalized)

F3a.what: confidence head updated online: Gloria logvar row only, replay buffer 16, prediction untouched

F3b.what: confidence head updated online: ridge on forecast-time features (-logvar, decode similarity, novelty) refit after each outcome on all past outcomes; -logvar until 8 outcomes exist

selection_rule: on the selection half only, per family: eligible if all predictions finite, max relative weight change <= 0.05, and MRR >= F0's MRR - 0.02; choose the smallest (monotonicity - control); ties go to the first in grid order. One configuration per family goes to the scoring half, scored once.

pass_bar_scoring_half.ranking: MRR >= F0's MRR on the same turns
pass_bar_scoring_half.confidence: Spearman(confidence, cosine error) <= -0.20 AND <= control (decode similarity) - 0.10
pass_bar_scoring_half.drift: max relative change of the updated weights <= 0.05; all forecasts finite
pass_bar_scoring_half.collapse: mean pairwise cosine of scoring-half predictions <= F0's + 0.05
pass_bar_scoring_half.cost: reported: median milliseconds per update on CPU (bar <= 250)

decision: a variant passes only if every bar holds. If one passes, it is implemented as an optional off-by-default online-update mode (anchored, rollback, update log). If none passes, nothing is implemented and the reading is reported.
